sections.heading: MAJOR IN FRENCH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including French 1900E or French 1910 or French 1999 with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course from: French 2905A/B and French 2906A/B (or French 2900).
2.0 courses: French 3305A/B, or French courses at the level above 3500 and below 3799.
